verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS platform with APIs (Deployments API, source map upload via API), so a downloadable API spec is a fair question. However, no evidence shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The official MCP server is a separate capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
